paragraphs.text: "Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?" —General Varchild, in a missive to King Darien of Kjeldor
"It's true I ask no fealty of the flocks—but surely we are more than mere beasts." —King Darien of Kjeldor, in a missive to General Varchild
"Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!" —King Darien of Kjeldor
"May they speed to their task, for the Skyknights alone cannot hold Kjeldor safe." —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
"More than lessons may be gained from the past." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"The first caravan has passed safely through the Karplusan Mountains without incident, forging a trade route to Balduvia. Kjeld himself would never have believed it!" —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Martyrs are cheaper than mercenaries, and a far better investment." —General Varchild
"The only true immortality is in dying for a cause." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"Only an animal born in the wild has sufficient heart to be a true Knight's steed." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"They are fighters as fine as any Knight they carry." —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
"We aided the Balduvians once before. They need but ask and we shall do so again." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords." —General Varchild
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"Kjeldor's borders are secure, and its citizens are prepared to take up arms in defense of their families." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Just as an Herbalist heals a wound, so must we heal the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"It's not so easy anymore. Nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"The benefits of peace far outweigh the pride of Generals." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Faith is our greatest protector." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"Strange alliances are alliances still, and provide the same protection." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"High in the Karplusans, death is swift and razor-clawed." —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
"What Barbarian secrets do they spy from their lofty perch?" —General Varchild
"At the core of all power is raw passion." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"I shape my weapons from the fears of my enemies." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare. The Explorers found their ancient enemies spawning everywhere.
Distant Atlantis charged these Explorers with the task of venturing into unknown waters to track the despised Viscerids.
"Once great literature—now great litter." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Far too many of our missing 'dead' seem to be turning up in Varchild's ranks!" —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Fool! Never believe they're dead until you see the body!" —General Varchild
"Lat-Nam has bequeathed us its secrets. With them we shall attain true enlightenment." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"In the arms of tragedy, there is little comfort in being right." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"It cannot be! Soldev crushed, and my machines to blame?" —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"To hide the truth is more than folly—it is fatal." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"Our underground archives grow daily, as our excavators and sages alike dig to uncover hidden wonders." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"It tells you that the worst is coming. Do you listen?" —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Watch for it! Right on its tailfeathers will be a storm from your nightmares." —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
A fallen Viscerid's only tribute is to be worn by a comrade.
One Viscerid's death is often another's gain.
Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .
"Whether whole or not, still we serve Lim-Dûl's wishes." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
"Only a necromancer would create such a foul form of divination." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"All knowledge has its price." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"The living cannot understand the benefits of death." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
"The burst of strength brought on by this plague should not be mistaken for a sign of renewed health." —Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid
"The fever clouds the mind as it energizes the body. Both will pass in time." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"The Guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
"Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we." —Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn
"When you cannot rely on your sources, trust your own senses. When you cannot trust those, you must follow your instincts." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Phyrexia's touch is painful to all but the blackest of hearts." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"People love to follow fools; they don't feel so alone then." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"An idiot cannot hear sense, even when a thousand people speak it." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"Disa is dead, and I am left. I shall allow no others to succumb to this pestilence." —Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid
"My lord, there is only so much I can do. This plague infests Krov worse than any other city." —Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest
"The Order of Stromgald spreads its poisonous lies from within Varchild's troops, and still she sees only visions of conquest." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"The 'fabled' Order of Stromgald is cast to the four winds, lost for all time. I, for one, give them no thought." —General Varchild
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Those mewling Barbarians will cower before my righteous steel!" —General Varchild
"We send our best to battle, but every man, woman, and child will stand against Varchild's butchers." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"GOTCHA!" —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Her soldiers' hatred for the Goblins is tempered only by their need for what the Goblins alone hold: knowledge of their mountain home." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Even the basest creatures may serve a purpose. Still, their lives need be only as long as the paths we tread." —General Varchild
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Each generation teaches the next that artifice is the enemy of natural order." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"The only 'art' these beasts possess is the art of noise!" —Jaya Ballard
"Theirs is the art of blood." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!" —General Varchild
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Anybody want some . . . *toast*?" —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Loyalty to coin alone is loyalty nonetheless." —General Varchild
"Let the lightning be your warning, and the thunder your battle cry." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!" —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"We could have peace, but Varchild would rather have the maps of the new Kjeldor drawn in Balduvian blood." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!" —General Varchild
"What tries to crush our spirit only strengthens our resolve." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Good soldiers rely first upon their training, then upon their instincts." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Teach by example. If your students do not survive, they were not worth the lesson." —General Varchild
"Beautiful, indeed—but one sting could fell a Giant in a heartbeat." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"There is no time for pain when this beast leaves its terrible sting." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"No one may fault an Elvish Ranger's heart, but the simplest frailty may fell even the proudest warrior." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"How can any Human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"All struggles ultimately require sacrifice. It's just that some sacrifices are dearer than others." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"Honor those who honor Fyndhorn above themselves." —Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid
"Their fury is their greatest weapon." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"Beneath serenity may lie a hidden rage." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"Oh, no—not *you* again?!" —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"In the soil of leadership sprout the seeds of immortality." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"If they can't take the hail, they'd better stay home." —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.
"Any who drink of Freyalise's bounty drink the mead of rebirth." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"There is, in each of us, the potential to heal and the gift of renewed life." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"It is the work of sorcery. Burn it!" —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"The art of war is turning obstacle to advantage." —Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate
"The Ancients teach us that if we can but last, we shall prevail." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter
"Few natural forces are as devastating as hunger." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"Relent, and you may transcend your situation." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form." —Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order
"Sacrilege! A noble ally in life, made nothing more than a glorified kite in death!" —Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
"A fine example of the rewards of artifice: a thoroughly obedient steed with wings of Soldevi steel." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.
Viscerid dams may be of living creatures as well as bones and mud.
The very ground yielded to Mishra's wishes.
"And *I* say north is where I *want* it to be!" —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"Knowing its origins, how could they have thought they could control it?" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"My Soldiers know that they need never fear for their protection." —King Darien of Kjeldor
"Look deep into the Grail, and see there what you desire most." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"A dreadful invention. What ease is there under the watchful eye of cold steel?" —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"Our newfound security enables us to turn more of our attentions to the wonders that lie deep within the soil." —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"Dagsson saw the steam as life-giving—until his followers felt its scalding touch." —Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic
"Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!" —Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist
"Humans and machines working together can be fearsome indeed!" —Arcum Dagsson
"Direct confrontation never was to the Orcs' taste." —General Varchild
After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.
